service.method: WITH RECURSIVE LINKED AS ( SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,MODULE ,PARENT::TEXT AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,PARENT ,COMBO ,PARENT || '_' || SORT AS TREE_ID FROM SBMMA WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND PARENT = '*' UNION ALL SELECT BMMA.HOUSE_CODE ,BMMA.MODULE ,L.TREE_ID::TEXT ,BMMA.PARENT ,BMMA.COMBO ,L.TREE_ID || '_' || BMMA.SORT FROM SBMMA BMMA JOIN LINKED L ON L.HOUSE_CODE = BMMA.HOUSE_CODE AND L.MODULE = BMMA.PARENT ) SELECT L.TREE_ID AS TREE_ID ,L.TREE_PARENT_ID AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,LANG.CONTENTS AS TREE_VALUE ,L.MODULE ,L.PARENT ,L.COMBO ,LANG.CONTENTS AS MODULE_NAME ,LANG2.CONTENTS AS DESCRIPTION FROM LINKED L JOIN SLANG LANG ON L.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND LANG.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE' AND LANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} AND LANG.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG2 ON L.HOUSE_CODE = LANG2.HOUSE_CODE AND LANG2.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE_DES' AND LANG2.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} AND LANG2.CODE = L.MODULE ORDER BY TREE_ID

WITH RECURSIVE LINKED AS ( SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,MODULE ,PARENT::TEXT AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,PARENT ,COMBO ,PARENT || '_' || SORT AS TREE_ID FROM SBMMA WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND PARENT = '*' UNION ALL SELECT BMMA.HOUSE_CODE ,BMMA.MODULE ,L.TREE_ID::TEXT ,BMMA.PARENT ,BMMA.COMBO ,L.TREE_ID || '_' || BMMA.SORT FROM SBMMA BMMA JOIN LINKED L ON L.HOUSE_CODE = BMMA.HOUSE_CODE AND L.MODULE = BMMA.PARENT ) SELECT L.TREE_ID AS TREE_ID ,L.TREE_PARENT_ID AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,LANG.CONTENTS AS TREE_VALUE ,L.MODULE ,L.PARENT ,L.COMBO ,LANG.CONTENTS AS MODULE_NAME ,LANG2.CONTENTS AS DESCRIPTION ,CASE WHEN NVL(CMAM.MODULE, '_NOT_SELECTED_') = '_NOT_SELECTED_' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS USE_FLAG ,CMAM.OPTION FROM LINKED L JOIN SLANG LANG ON L.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND LANG.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE' AND LANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} AND LANG.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG2 ON L.HOUSE_CODE = LANG2.HOUSE_CODE AND LANG2.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE_DES' AND LANG2.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} AND LANG2.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMAM CMAM ON CMAM.MODULE = L.MODULE AND CMAM.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY TREE_ID
